hypothesis: Partition down projection output rows into four complete-K convolutions, concatenate outputs.

target.dtype: BF16 Metal / INT8 FFN weights and FP16 ANE activations

tensor_gate.policy: Use unchanged original oracle thresholds pinned by the local maintainer; this proposal supplies none.
tensor_gate.required: Original component/driver oracle, all captured KV/seed outputs, and complete unchanged reference continuation. Token agreement alone is insufficient.
extra_checks: no altered RMS gamma or FP32 statistics
accepted ten-step FP16 ANE GELU materializations

timing.phase: normal disaggregated route; not instrumented prefill-only capture I/O
timing.accept: Both baseline and candidate repeats satisfy the predeclared drift gate; paired complete-route median improves by at least the predeclared 2%, no material stage regression; all originals pass; independent confirmation required. No winner from compilation/static counts.
timing.early_eos_or_different_work: Do not pad; reject work-count comparability and use a new separately pinned protocol.
record_separately: compilation and load time outside timing

key_risks: Private compiler may serialize or add layout copies; no split-K sum or removed FP16 boundary.
Native compiler and accelerator correctness are unrun in the research environment.
queue_admission: Local owner only, new job ID and fresh output. Do not edit attempted manifests, reuse old receipts, touch STOP markers or auto-launch from this proposal.
matched_controls: same instrumented executable and source revision
same model revision and original reference
same prompt and requested output count
same trace/capture flags and retention/interleave policy
same Metal baseline MMA32 and SIMD-attention flags
zero ANE compiler calls inside timing
